high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from a YouTube video. The video is titled "Israel Calls For US Strikes" and has garnered 4,07,928 views as of the time the screenshot was taken (22 hours ago). The creator of the video is Preston Stewart, who has 8.89 lakh subscribers. The top part of the image shows an aerial view of Tabriz Air Base in Iran, dated June 14, 2025. The image includes annotations pointing out damaged structures within the base. There is also a map inset showing the location of Tabriz Air Base relative to Iran
